Two of them are rules about the shape of the codebase, and they run on every pull request." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="1300" x="40" y="50" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="start" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="./gradlew build" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="220" x="40" y="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="check" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="check" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="220" x="40" y="190" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a0" edge="1" parent="1" source="start" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#333333;endArrow=block;" target="check"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=12;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=10;" value="Gate 1 · schema compatibility
:contracts:test · SchemaCompatibilityTest

Every .avsc must be mutually readable with the committed baseline. Offline: no registry, so the gate is deterministic and cannot be changed by the current contents of a shared registry.

Also checks that no schema disappears from the baseline, and that every schema stays in the dev.engnotes.fes.events namespace.

Fails on: field removal, type change, mandatory field with no default." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="230" width="500" x="340" y="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=12;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=10;" value="Gate 2 · plane isolation
checkPlaneIsolation

No module under services/ingestion, services/streaming or services/audit may depend on a :services:agent project, or on a dependency whose group starts with org.neo4j, com.anthropic, dev.langchain4j or io.github.ollama4j.

Configuration-cache safe: violations are collected at configuration time into plain serializable data.

Prints the module count, so a vacuous pass is visible." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="230" width="500" x="340" y="350" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=12;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=10;" value="Gate 3 · ACL policies render
renderKafkaAcls

Reads every services/*/*/src/main/resources/security/kafka-acls.yml with the same parser the tests use and writes build/kafka-acls.args.

Runs on every build so a malformed or unrenderable policy fails here, rather than days later when someone brings up the strict-security stack.

Fails outright if no policy file is found: every service commits one." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="230" width="540" x="880" y="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=12;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=10;" value="Gate 4 · the tests
every module's check task

143 tests across 27 classes at the last full run.

Unit tests: pure logic, no Spring context.
Integration tests: KafkaAvroStack, a real broker on apache/kafka-native:4.1.0 plus a real Schema Registry.
Authorization tests: SecureKafkaStack, a real broker on apache/kafka:4.1.0 with SASL and the StandardAuthorizer.

A running Docker daemon is required." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="230" width="540" x="880" y="350" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a1" edge="1" parent="1" source="check" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#b85450;endArrow=block;" target="g1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a2" edge="1" parent="1" source="check" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#b85450;endArrow=block;" target="g2"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a3" edge="1" parent="1" source="g1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#d79b00;endArrow=block;" target="g3"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a4" edge="1" parent="1" source="g2" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#82b366;endArrow=block;" target="g4"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ci" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f9f9f9;strokeColor=#cccccc;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=8;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" value="On every pull request · .github/workflows/ci.yml" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="220" width="1380" x="40" y="620" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ci1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="Java 25, corretto

div.div:
Gate 1 · schema compatibility
:contracts:test · SchemaCompatibilityTest
Every .avsc must be mutually readable with the committed baseline. Offline: no registry, so the gate is deterministic and cannot be changed by the current contents of a shared registry.
Also checks that no schema disappears from the baseline, and that every schema stays in the dev.engnotes.fes.events namespace.
Fails on: field removal, type change, mandatory field with no default.

div.div:
Gate 2 · plane isolation
checkPlaneIsolation
No module under services/ingestion, services/streaming or services/audit may depend on a :services:agent project, or on a dependency whose group starts with org.neo4j, com.anthropic, dev.langchain4j or io.github.ollama4j.
Configuration-cache safe: violations are collected at configuration time into plain serializable data.
Prints the module count, so a vacuous pass is visible.

div.div:
Gate 3 · ACL policies render
renderKafkaAcls
Reads every services/*/*/src/main/resources/security/kafka-acls.yml with the same parser the tests use and writes build/kafka-acls.args.
Runs on every build so a malformed or unrenderable policy fails here, rather than days later when someone brings up the strict-security stack.
Fails outright if no policy file is found: every service commits one.

div.div:
Gate 4 · the tests
every module's check task
143 tests across 27 classes at the last full run.
Unit tests: pure logic, no Spring context.
Integration tests: KafkaAvroStack, a real broker on apache/kafka-native:4.1.0 plus a real Schema Registry.
Authorization tests: SecureKafkaStack, a real broker on apache/kafka:4.1.0 with SASL and the StandardAuthorizer.
A running Docker daemon is required.
